milestones.label: Daniel approaches client one if all gates pass

tasks.title: Publish day-by-day engineering plan
tasks.acceptance: Order all frozen P0 items, name dependencies and daily evidence, and agree on the 25 September checkpoint with Tega.
tasks.evidence: docs/LAUNCH_DAY_BY_DAY_2026-09-23.md prepared; awaiting Tega's confirmation of dates and dependencies.
tasks.note: This tracker is the initial shared plan. Dates remain proposals until Tega confirms them.

tasks.title: Explain every terminal scheduled reply outcome
tasks.acceptance: Every terminal writer records a coded cause, time, step and branch context, and a generation trace or explicit no-generation reason. Separate generation exhaustion from declared hold. Re-run the exact 18–20 September classification and disclose unrecoverable historical gaps.
tasks.evidence: Production /api/version: babfae8cd40e7d55c16abd803daa611d65ff4c56. 24h monitor on 23 September: 207 historical terminal rows, 0 claim snapshots, 0 trace links, 0 missing reason/time after migration. Forward live proof and historical classification are pending.
tasks.note: Commit babfae8 is deployed. Migration appears present because production reads the new columns. Do not mark verified from migration backfill alone.

tasks.title: Close ManyChat to Convlo first-reply handoff
tasks.acceptance: One continuous follower trigger, visible opener, lead reply, accepted callback, canonical identity, correct Step 1 branch, outbound Meta ID and normal continuation. Preserve planned/provider-reported/Meta-confirmed opener states.
tasks.note: Needs ManyChat and Meta access. Tega must approve a direct-webhook fallback before any routing change.

tasks.title: Prove handoff races, replay and direct inbound
tasks.acceptance: Callback-first, native-first, concurrent and replay cases reuse one conversation and reply operation; callback failures are visible; direct inbound chooses its own branch; production revision and rollback are recorded.

tasks.title: Explain five silent delivery losses
tasks.acceptance: Reconstruct user_7_eham, padihcee, martinghantous, kemical12_music and israelalge3. Reproduce each in controlled tests. Each ends in a correlated Meta result or coded cause visible to the owner, with no silent exhaustion or duplicate send.
tasks.note: Preserve historical jobs, attempts and review flags. No automatic replay.

tasks.title: Find Step 14 exhaustion and repeat root cause
tasks.acceptance: Check whether d3b4321 covers Steps 10–14; trace syed_10129, lukooyafarid and padihcee through branch, prompt, quality gate, cursor and delivery. Prove the fix on the active script.
tasks.note: Coordinate with purchase gate P0.6; do not assume purchase copy is the only cause.

tasks.title: Route non-sales intent before discovery
tasks.acceptance: Partnership, seller, support, hardship and other non-sales turns exit discovery by branch decision. Unclear greetings prompt clarification.

tasks.title: Guard every outgoing script action against context
tasks.acceptance: A beginner request does not receive unsupported obstacle or urgency copy. New inbound invalidates incompatible pending parts before send.

tasks.title: Answer explicit questions before advancing
tasks.acceptance: Product, access, platform and terminology questions receive an approved answer or an explicit human handoff before another funnel question. Preserve resume point.

tasks.title: Treat clear interest as YES
tasks.acceptance: A prospect saying “100%, what is it?” gets an explanation and valid qualification without another permission prompt.

tasks.title: Validate state transitions and reject stale writes
tasks.acceptance: Allowed transitions and prerequisites are explicit. Qualified affordability proceeds to the link. Backward moves have a recorded reason. Out-of-order jobs cannot overwrite newer state.
tasks.note: Legacy computeSystemStage owns the production cursor; FSM-only changes do not close this.

tasks.title: Require purchase evidence before welcome or access
tasks.acceptance: “Got it,” “I’m in,” “send it” and product questions do not trigger purchase welcome. Explicit purchase evidence is recorded; access entitlement requires backend verification.
tasks.note: Tega approves product copy and facts.

tasks.title: Use approved resource IDs and correct links
tasks.acceptance: The free YouTube resource and paid Session Playbook use their approved URLs. Labels match resources; each send records resource, request, result and recipient.

tasks.title: Resend requested resources exactly once
tasks.acceptance: “Send it again” resends the intended resource once. Ambiguous requests clarify. Redelivery of the same inbound event cannot duplicate the resend.

tasks.title: Ship owner review and resume on a phone
tasks.acceptance: Durable NEEDS_STEERING hold and one inbox item show draft, reason and context. Owner can approve, edit, guide, keep paused or resume without a draft. Stale and duplicate actions are safe. Both declared holds and exhaustion enter review; phone test passes unaided.
tasks.note: Preserve Junior Narandan, user_7_eham, padihcee, kemical12_music, israelalge3 and sumit_thakre156 as before-state evidence.

tasks.title: Prove accepted inbound outcomes and alerts
tasks.acceptance: Monitoring covers the full interval and older conversations, separates IG/FB, ties each inbound to a job and outbound or hold, and alerts on actionable age/failure thresholds. Test restarts, timeout, rejection and exhaustion.

tasks.title: Prove real Facebook lead and continuation
tasks.acceptance: A real Facebook DM opens the 24-hour window; new and continuing turns reach one conversation, select the correct script step, deliver once through Meta, and store the Meta message ID. Save job/trace IDs and before/after state.
tasks.note: Wait for Shazim's live message before starting a production send test.

tasks.title: Prove real Instagram lead and continuation
tasks.acceptance: A real Instagram DM opens the 24-hour window; opener provenance, first reply, next script step and continuing turn are correlated to one conversation and delivered once with Meta message IDs.
tasks.note: Wait for Shazim's live message. Do not duplicate a natural inbound with a synthetic webhook.

tasks.title: Write architecture and release evidence handoff
tasks.acceptance: Document intake, identity, runtime cursor, generation, queue, egress, review/resume, flags, rollback, known gaps and exact evidence for each P0 item.

tasks.title: Read-only AI cost dashboard
tasks.acceptance: Cost per conversation uses real token records from the trace table.

tasks.title: Set pricing and positioning
tasks.acceptance: Setup fee, monthly fee, included volume, overage and one-line competitor answer are approved for Daniel.

tasks.title: Publish terms, privacy policy and client agreement
tasks.acceptance: Privacy policy and terms are published; client agreement covers trial, data and support expectations.

tasks.title: Prepare intake and onboarding run-book
tasks.acceptance: Intake captures offer, audience, links, script goal, success event and payment system; run-book covers signed to live.

tasks.title: Prove demo account on a second script
tasks.acceptance: A second account and script run without hardcoded Daniel-specific behavior.

tasks.title: Verify and sign off every P0 gate
tasks.acceptance: Every P0 item has a commit, production version, script version, test input, conversation, job/trace IDs, before/after state and observed result. No open launch blocker.

tasks.title: Confirm conditions for client one
tasks.acceptance: Daniel receives approved price and positioning and confirms all P0 launch conditions before outreach.

tasks.title: Approach and onboard first paying client
tasks.acceptance: Client one is approached after sign-off, signs with a written success event, then completes two weeks of live volume before use as proof for client two.

tasks.title: Acknowledge each lead's stated goal
tasks.acceptance: Step 5 responds to wealth, learning, family, freedom and consistency goals without a universal materialism comparison.

tasks.title: Improve obstacle diagnosis
tasks.acceptance: Remove the blanket 99% claim. Recognize education, time and capital needs directly; urgency requires a real obstacle and goal.

tasks.title: Store structured facts with sources and confidence
tasks.acceptance: Location, experience, job, goal, obstacle, urgency, interest, affordability, resources and purchase evidence are stored with source messages and corrected when the lead updates them.

tasks.title: Handle images and attachments honestly
tasks.acceptance: Supported images are understood, or the assistant states the limitation and offers handoff. Chart questions do not silently resume discovery.

tasks.title: Resume returning conversations with context
tasks.acceptance: Prior conversation, customer status, resources and human interaction inform the next objective. The assistant acknowledges prior contact.

tasks.title: Disclose automation and route human requests
tasks.acceptance: Bot accusations get an honest disclosure. Explicit requests for Dae or a person interrupt the script and route to human review.

tasks.title: Explain the offer before discussing price
tasks.acceptance: Approved product inclusions, audience, access and post-purchase process answer “What do I get?” before affordability. Unknown facts escalate.

tasks.title: Bound educational detours
tasks.acceptance: A configurable limit lets the assistant answer briefly and then offer the right resource or resume qualification without forcing a pitch in non-sales or distress cases.

tasks.title: Use gender-neutral language by default
tasks.acceptance: Templates and generated replies avoid default gendered address, never infer gender from names or photos, and honor explicit preferences.

tasks.title: Find why blocked verbatim repeats were generated
tasks.acceptance: Trace the repeated candidate replies in syed_10129 and nonyethegreat and verify whether Step 14 repair stops generation of duplicate content.

tasks.title: Refresh UI design tokens and app layout
tasks.acceptance: Tega and Daniel approve a scoped redesign after launch reliability is stable.

tasks.title: Derive script builder rules from Daniel's versions
tasks.acceptance: Compare approved script revisions and turn recurring script choices into explicit builder rules.

tasks.title: Ingest completion, payment and booking events
tasks.acceptance: External completion, payment and booking events update Convlo through authenticated, deduplicated webhooks with traceable provenance.
